info.title: karastream
info.author: doomtrain14
info.details: Karastream is a media center for the Nintendo Switch that works with the Stremio addon protocol. You browse catalogs from addons and pick a stream. Karastream then plays it, either over HTTP or straight from a torrent with its own built-in BitTorrent engine.\n\nAI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: icon/banner art.
